content.text:
Write a natural short email exchange. Subject: Dinner. Participants: Me, Ben; Me is the owner's speaker label, not a spoken name. Date: 2026-10-13, local time 10:00–10:20.
Scenario: Ben emails from work about moving their already arranged dinner; the user replies. Use an ordinary reply chain, not an introduction.

The conversation must naturally and unambiguously establish each of these facts (they are authoring constraints, not lines to copy):
1. Ben asks to move their Thursday dinner to Saturday. The user agrees to Saturday at 7 pm at Juniper Cafe, replacing Thursday.
Use 2–12 short emails. The subject is header metadata; do not put a Subject: prefix inside an email body. Return only valid JSON with dialogue (a string with one Name: body line per email) and writer_note (a short string about the choices). No prose or Markdown fences outside the JSON.

output.encrypted_content: <encrypted reasoning retained in private run artifact>

Enforcing JSON-only output with labeled dialogue lines and a writer note while avoiding the speaker label in the body text.
